blocking_findings.summary: The successor bridge did not bind the installed checkpoint-set digest to the validated identity-stage digest.
Bundle binding admitted a result-bundle view in the numerical-producer slot, bypassing required producer order and provenance.
Package-terminal construction lacked a one-shot no-replace gate and could emit multiple terminals for one package identity.
The successor consumer coordinator omitted the required sealed V11-closure binding, causing the production path to fail after irreversible numerical execution.
The prompt-bound consumer wrapper did not bind its outer role to the exact role and producer kind of the wrapped historical consumer view.

unresolved_findings: qualification-only result-bundle indices were not structurally excluded from live authority
the blast radius of the missing checkpoint-set continuity check was not mechanically bounded
the missing V11-closure production field had not been exercised as a production-path regression
advisory_findings: some structural mutations were self-referential rather than downstream consumer attacks
the deterministic aggregate did not bind all stable preinstallation authority digests
Python object.__new__ can bypass constructor seals outside the supported API
the raw identity validator remains a public compatibility surface
the production successor coordinator entry point lacked a direct no-access qualification
